meta.name: discord-get-messages
meta.description: Retrieve messages from Discord channels via the Discord API. Use this skill when the user wants to read, search, or analyze messages from a Discord channel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 Discord 频道读取消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过 API 获取 Discord 消息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to fetch Discord messages via API

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Discord API 从指定频道获取消息，你可以让它读取最近消息、按条件搜索或查看历史记录。
howto.when: 当你想读取、搜索或分析 Discord 频道中的消息时，Claude 会自动调用这个技能来获取数据。

say.text: 从 Discord 频道 #general 获取最近 10 条消息。
say.note: Claude 会返回该频道最新 10 条消息。

say.text: 搜索 #support 频道里包含“bug”的消息，最多 100 条。
say.note: Claude 会先获取消息再过滤关键词。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can retrieve messages from a specified Discord channel via the Discord API. It can fetch recent messages, search by criteria, or view history.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to read, search, or analyze messages from a Discord channel. Claude will use this skill to fetch the data.

say_en.text: Get the latest 10 messages from Discord channel #general.
say_en.note: Claude returns the most recent 10 messages.

say_en.text: Get 50 messages before message ID 987654321 in channel 123456789012345678.
say_en.note: Claude paginates to fetch messages before that ID.

say_en.text: Search #support channel for messages containing 'bug', up to 100.
say_en.note: Claude fetches messages then filters by keyword.
